thesis_summary.thesis: Applied Optoelectronics designs and manufactures fiber-optic networking products for internet data centers, cable television, telecom, and fiber-to-the-home markets. **[Fact]** The company is vertically integrated: it fabricates laser chips in Sugar Land, Texas, and assembles transceivers and equipment in Taiwan and China. **[Fact]** FY2025 revenue was **$455.7 million** (+83% versus FY2024); gross profit **$136.9 million** (30.0% margin). **[Fact]** End markets in FY2025 were data center **43%**, CATV **54%**, telecom **3%**, and FTTH **<1%** of revenue. **[Fact]** The company employed **4,691** people at year-end 2025, mostly in China and Taiwan manufacturing.
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: **Predictive attribute:** complexity discount (small-cap optical supplier with 95% revenue from five customers, heavy China/Taiwan manufacturing, and episodic equity raises).
